dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you know a lot of people?

dialogues.speaker: Boucicaut
dialogues.text: Indeed, and not merely people from Fontaine, no — I have many friends from abroad.

dialogues.speaker: Boucicaut
dialogues.text: I've been a traveling merchant since I was young, but as my journey wore on, I felt that spending my days peacefully at home suited me better.
